queries.result: First-party Kadaster and PDOK results identify the national BRK Kadastrale Kaart as the official public cadastral-map route, available through viewer, web services and OGC API. The official service is national rather than Tilburg-owned.

registryEvidence.custodian: Kadaster / Basisregistratie Kadaster (BRK), published through the Dutch national PDOK platform
registryEvidence.scopeNote: Tilburg is evidenced by returned native cadastral properties (kadastrale_gemeente_waarde=Tilburg); the public geometry service is national PDOK/Kadaster, not a Tilburg municipal endpoint.

parcelDiscovery.crs: OGC CRS84 response (longitude/latitude); storage CRS EPSG:28992 also documented by collection metadata
parcelDiscovery.note: The bounded response intersects the exact WUP point vicinity and returned three valid Tilburg parcels. Retained feature properties contain only a canonical composite native identity.

HTTP 200 JSON; collection exposed native collection perceel, CRS84/EPSG:28992/EPSG:3857/EPSG:4258, national extent, and storage CRS EPSG:28992.

compositeKeyProvenance: The retained id combines the returned namespace NL.IMKAD.KadastraalObject with the returned identificatie_lokaal_id; it is not a synthetic row number. Source-specific fields remain metadata-only.
uncertainty: The source is a national Kadaster/PDOK service rather than a Tilburg-owned registry endpoint.
The sample is bounded and is not evidence of complete Tilburg coverage or legal survey accuracy; Kadaster states the cadastral map is indicative and no exact measurements should be derived.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
This packet records research evidence only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
